Agentic AI tools are changing how empirical research gets done. This site hosts the Q-LAB teaching material for [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs), organized by audience.

## 🎓 For Q-LAB research assistants

A 4-hour hands-on course (August 17–18, 2026), from **zero knowledge** to running real research tasks.

| Session | Deck | Topics |
|---------|------|--------|
| **Day 1** (2h) | [Foundations](ras/day1-foundations.html) | claude.ai vs. Cowork vs. Claude Code · the agent loop · `/init` & `CLAUDE.md` · permission modes · **Plan Mode** |
| **Day 2** (2h) | [Power Tools](ras/day2-power-tools.html) | custom commands & subagents · **MCP** servers · dashboards · **`/deep-research`** · **Whisper** for paper discussions · the Sant'Anna academic workflow |

## 👩‍🏫 For faculty — Facultad de Ciencias Sociales

Two 3-hour sessions for professors, taught step by step in Spanish, with no technical background assumed.

| Sesión | Deck | Temas |
|--------|------|-------|
| **Sesión 1** (3h) | [Confianza y verificación](profesores/sesion1-confianza.html) | qué es y qué no es · seguridad · terminal mínimo · `/init` · **la trampa de la cita** · biblioteca PUCP |
| **Sesión 2** (3h) | [El flujo de investigación](profesores/sesion2-flujo.html) | Plan Mode · **`/deep-research`** · de PDFs a base de datos · LaTeX sin escribir LaTeX · **Whisper** |

The written guide (guion + manual) is in [`profesores/README.md`](https://github.com/alexanderquispe/claude-code-research/blob/main/profesores/README.md).

**Example project.** Both sessions run on [`ejemplo-mineria-conflicto/`](https://github.com/alexanderquispe/claude-code-research/tree/main/ejemplo-mineria-conflicto) — a real, half-started and deliberately messy research project on **mining and social conflict in Peru**. It combines structured data (mining output and employment, dialogue-table commitments, 251 congressional bills as JSON) with unstructured text (ten monthly conflict reports from the Ombudsman's Office, each with a narrative description per case). Instructor's guide and answer key: [`profesores/guia-ejemplo.md`](https://github.com/alexanderquispe/claude-code-research/blob/main/profesores/guia-ejemplo.md).

## Before class

- A [GitHub](https://github.com) account and [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com) installed
- Claude Code installed and logged in: `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash`
- The **Claude Code** extension for VS Code

- Pedro H. C. Sant'Anna — [*My Claude Code Workflow*](https://psantanna.com/claude-code-my-workflow/workflow-guide.html) and the [claude-code-my-workflow](https://github.com/pedrohcgs/claude-code-my-workflow) template
